about_the_game:
Curse of the Abyss is a Traditional Roguelike with a twist.

Floors fall as you move around, limiting your movement

Kill enemy to drop resources. Every item dropped is unique to the enemy.

Every enemy also has an elite version, which has their own unique relics.

Plan your route down into the abyss and slay the guardians of the abyss.

Features

As the game is still in development, content are expected to changed. However, here are what can be expected in the game.

  • Different biomes with different features and enemies.

  • Each enemy will have their own unique item drop.

  • Each enemy will have a elite version and a unique relic that is dropped from the elite.

  • Each biome will have their own Guardian.

  • Different characters to choose from.

  • A Campaign mode where it will feature some extraction elements.

  • A true Roguelike mode where you try to kill as many Guardians in a single run as possible.

Additional Information

The game will be a highly tactical and spatial Traditional Roguelike, with heavy emphasis on resource management. There will be minimum to no meta progression, making players' skill the focus of the game.

Demo Note

As the game is still in active development, many of the features of the game is subjected to change. The demo is a vertical slice of the game. If you enjoy the demo, do wishlist the game. I will also be adding 1 or 2 new characters to the demo in the future.
